prose: Do we live in a simulation? Is everything an illusion? Are the Earth and our bodies prisons which we need to escape from?

Chance Garton is a researcher, Biofield Tuning practitioner and the host of the InnerVerse Podcast. He returns today to share his latest research debunking New Age Gnosticism and the Simulation Theory. Through the lens of Astrotheology and ancient symbolism we dive deep into how the distortions and misinterpretations of Gnostic texts manifest.
